Your information

Privacy information

Reading and reflection

The reflection prompts do not collect or store your answers. If you choose to write, use your own notebook or a tool of your choice.

Question finder

The question finder filters answers in your browser. Its text is not saved, placed in the URL, sent to a model, or included in analytics events by this tool. It is not a live AI conversation. General website analytics still operate as described below.

Information you choose to send

Mind Clarity receives information you choose to share by email or WhatsApp. Please do not send card numbers, bank details, OTPs, or passwords.

Analytics preferences

Google Analytics measures page visits, navigation between learning pages, and engaged reading. The question finder text and your reflection answers are not included in these events.

Choose whether to allow analytics on this browser. Your choice is stored locally and can be changed here at any time.

Choose your analytics preference below.

Disable analyticsAllow analytics

Browser preferences and service providers

Your selected language and analytics preference are stored in this browser. Google provides analytics, Cloudflare delivers the website and helps protect it from automated abuse, and email and WhatsApp handle interactions you choose to start with those services.

Contact us if you want to ask about information you have sent directly. Reflection answers and question-finder searches are not collected by this website.

Questions

For privacy questions, contact pudaykumar12@gmail.com.
